proposals.evidence: DEDR 410(b) explicitly lists Tamil iṉṟu/iṉṟaikku/iṟṟai, Malayalam innu, Kota inḏy, Toda ïḏ, Kannada indu, Kodagu indï, Tulu ini/inne, Gadaba ine(n), Kurux innā, Malto ine and Brahui ainō/annō today. These lexical temporal formations are cited to subsection (b), with the observed nṟ/nd/nn variants and Tamil-type dative temporal ending preserved; no unsupported separate day constituent is asserted.
